title: Host settings & payout preferences
subtitle: Configure Algerian bank payouts (CCP / bank RIB), booking rules, host identity and communication channels.

payouts.title: Algerian payout accounts (DZD)
payouts.description: Earnings are paid out automatically in Algerian dinars (DZD) 24 hours after guest check-in.

history.title: Disbursement & payout history
history.description: All transfers are processed via Algérie Poste CCP or BNA interbank clearing.

identity.title: Hosting account type & verification
identity.description: Manage your individual host registration or your tourism agency workspace credentials.
identity.complianceBody: Hosting activities on DARNA follow Algerian tourism and tax regulations. Individual hosts are registered as auto-entrepreneurs or individuals. Agencies must provide their Trade Register number (RC) and tax identification number (NIF).

defaults.title: Global booking parameters
defaults.description: Set standard rules that apply to your existing and future listings.
defaults.instantDesc: Guests book automatically without host review. Maximum conversion and instant bookings.
defaults.requestDesc: You review the guest's profile and message before confirming. A response within 24h is required.
defaults.advanceDays: {count, plural, one {At least # day before arrival} other {At least # days before arrival}}
defaults.cancellationFlexible: Flexible: full refund up to 1 day before check-in
defaults.cancellationModerate: Moderate: full refund up to 5 days before check-in
defaults.cancellationStrict: Strict: full refund up to 14 days before check-in, 50% from 13 to 7 days

notifications.title: Guest communication & SMS alerts
notifications.description: Configure automatic welcome notes and mobile alerts on Algerian networks (Mobilis, Djezzy, Ooredoo).
notifications.smsDesc: Get an instant SMS when a traveler books or cancels on your listing.
notifications.emailDesc: Receive inquiry summaries and weekly earnings digests.
notifications.welcomeLabel: Automatic welcome message (sent as soon as a booking is confirmed)
notifications.welcomeDefault: Salam alaykoum! Thank you for booking your stay with us in Algeria. We look forward to welcoming you. Please let us know your estimated arrival time.

toasts.defaultsSaved: Booking parameters and approval mode saved.
toasts.agencyUpgradeRequested: Agency upgrade requested. Our team will verify your Trade Register (RC).
